notes: 16 review-decision cases. Eval method: a subagent applies SKILL.md + references to each prompt and returns {fires, decision, entry, target, topology}, graded vs expected. Covers trigger-vs-defer (defers to coding/debug/deprecation-audit/perf-audit/security-audit/override-finding/ui-review), entry path (pasted-block or single non-git file -> direct-reviewer skip-scoper; git target -> scoper-first), TARGET derivation (local/pr/worktree), and topology (single / multi / domain-partition at >~8 modules). id 14 guards the odoo-ui-review near-miss (a shared 'does this look correct?' trigger phrase); ids 15-16 guard the POST-to-PR and autonomous-fix-loop behaviors. Baseline (pre-optimize snapshot) scored 16/16; the eval guards against decision regressions, it does NOT execute reviewers or grade finding quality.
